salary_details.details: Personnel engaged on Short Term Basis will be inducted in the E0 Pay Scale (2017) of DPE, i.e. Rs. 30,000 – 1,20,000. The basic pay is Rs. 30,000, and an annual increment of 3% on the basic pay is admissible in the second and third year. | Maximum Rs. 25,000/- per annum towards reimbursement of Medical Insurance Coverage up to Rs. 10 Lakhs. Proof of the insurance policy must be submitted within three months of engagement. These personnel are not entitled to any other medical benefits in the Company's IHCs / Dispensaries. Casual Leave, Vacation Leave, Compensatory Off as applicable to regular Officers, and Vacation Leave Encashment (on completion / termination of the Tenure). Uniforms, Stitching Charges and Shoe Allowance as applicable to regular Officers. Maternity Benefits, Creche facilities and Paternity Leave as applicable to regular officers. Provident Fund contributions as per rules. Gratuity will be paid on completion of the Term or discontinuation of the term due to resignation, termination, etc., subject to completion of one year of service on pro-rata basis. TA/DA benefits (joining Duty, Temporary Duty and Transfers) as applicable to regular officers at Grade-I. Personnel with Benchmark Disabilities: Special Allowance to Blind / Orthopedically disabled personnel, Transport Allowance to Blind / Orthopedically disabled / Deaf & Dumb Employees (as applicable), and Special Casual Leave, as applicable to regular officers. Periodical medical check-up for self. Company Quarters, wherever available. | Junior Executives on short term basis will not be entitled to any allowances or benefits other than those indicated in the notification. | Selected candidates will be engaged for a maximum period of 3 years from the date of engagement. The tenure ends automatically on completion of 3 years from the date of joining, without any further notice, and there will be no extension. The engagement can be terminated at any time by either party by giving one month's notice or payment of the Basic+DA in lieu of the notice. An Undertaking will be obtained at the time of joining that the engagement is temporary in nature and will automatically cease after 3 years. Selected candidates may be transferred, posted or assigned to any place where HAL has Divisions / Offices / Bases, depending on organizational requirements. No request for change of posting will be entertained after joining. The Short Term Engagement does not confer any right to claim the status of regular executives of the Company.

selection_process: The selection of candidates will be done through Interview only. There is no written test mentioned in the notification.

Shortlisting: Candidates who fulfil the prescribed eligibility criteria are considered for shortlisting. They are shortlisted on the basis of aggregate marks scored in the qualifying course / examination
in order of merit

in the ratio of 1:10 (maximum) to the number of vacancies in each discipline and category. Interview: The suitability of shortlisted candidates is assessed by a Selection Committee by way of Interview. The date
time and venue will be intimated to shortlisted candidates only via e-mail

and the list of shortlisted candidates will be hosted on the HAL website. Final Selection: Selection against the posts notified for each Discipline is made on the basis of performance in the Interview. Candidates must secure at least 50% marks in the Interview to qualify (relaxation for SC / ST / PwBD candidates as per rules).
How shortlisting works: all Unreserved candidates of each discipline
along with SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS candidates of that discipline who do not avail any relaxation
are grouped together

arranged in descending order of merit and called in the ratio of 1:10 in the UR category. SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS candidates not shortlisted under UR are regrouped with their respective categories and called in the ratio of 1:10 in their respective category. If marks in the qualifying examination are the same
the candidate who is elder or senior in age is considered first. Merely meeting the qualification does not entitle a candidate to be shortlisted for the Interview.

All candidates called for Interview must produce certificates in original for all particulars declared in the Application Form at the Document Verification stage prior to the Interview. Candidates in SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS / PwBD (disability of 40% or more) categories must submit copies of the Caste Certificate / Income & Asset Certificate / Disability Certificate
as applicable
in the prescribed format at the time of Interview / Document Verification. Candidates employed in Central Government or State Government Departments
Public Sector Enterprises
Autonomous Organizations
Quasi Government Organizations
Armed Forces or Para-Military Forces (Regular
Contractual or on Contract basis) must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at Document Verification. If NOC does not apply

a document from the employer citing the same must be produced. Candidates who fail to submit these will not be permitted to appear for the Interview and will not be eligible for Travelling Allowance. Engagement is subject to verification of Caste / Income & Asset / Disability Certificate (wherever applicable) and Character & Antecedents. The vacancies are to be filled by external candidates only through Direct Recruitment. Applications of internal candidates
if any
will not be considered.
Candidates provisionally selected by HAL
including PwBDs

must undergo a Pre-employment Medical Examination before joining. Appointment is subject to a satisfactory medical report from the Company's Doctor as per the Medical Standards of the Company. The decision of the Company's Doctor is final and binding. No relaxation in health standards will be allowed. For PwBDs

suitability for appointment in relation to the disability will be decided on the basis of reports of the Medical Board attached to the Special Employment Exchanges for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. Their appointment will be provisional until then
and is subject to verification of the Disability Certificate as per Company Rules.
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must apply online only through the Careers section of the HAL website, www.hal-india.co.in, from 07.10.2026 (14:00 hrs) to 17.10.2026 (14:00 hrs). Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted.
A valid e-mail ID that remains active till the completion of the Selection Process.
A valid mobile number. Intimation about further stages such as the Interview will be sent to the same e-mail ID, and requests to change the mobile number or e-mail ID later will not be entertained.
Soft copy of the latest passport size colour photograph and signature in .jpg format, less than 100 KB and 50 KB in size respectively.
Educational details such as semester-wise marks.
Employment details (if applicable).
Step 1: Click the link "Engagement of Junior Executives on Short term Basis-2026" given at www.hal-india.co.in (careers section) to start registration.

Step 2: Fill in the Eligibility Details accurately. On submission, a unique Application number is generated and you are routed to the personal and qualification details page. Eligibility details cannot be edited once submitted. After the application number is generated, you can re-login to complete the application.

Step 3: Fill in the Personal, Qualification and other details of the application form as per the instructions of the detailed advertisement. You may edit the details using the Edit option before final submission. SC / ST / PwBD candidates: after submitting the Personal, Qualification etc. details, the registration process is completed on the application confirmation page. UR / OBC-NCL / EWS candidates: after submitting these details, you must make the online payment through SBI Collect.
SC / ST / PwBD candidates: after submitting the Personal, Qualification etc. details, the registration process is completed on the application confirmation page.
UR / OBC-NCL / EWS candidates: after submitting these details, you must make the online payment through SBI Collect.

Step 4 (UR / OBC-NCL / EWS only): Pay the application fee online using a preferred payment mode (credit card / Internet Banking / UPI etc.). Validation of the payment is likely to take 48 to 72 hours, after which you should re-visit the application page with your credentials. After successful validation, you can download the final submitted Application Form. This is not applicable to SC / ST / PwBD candidates.

Apply for only ONE Engineering Discipline. If more than one application is submitted for different Disciplines, all such applications will be summarily rejected and the application fee paid, if any, will be forfeited. If more than one application is submitted for the same Discipline, only the last submitted application will be considered.
An application once submitted cannot be altered under any circumstances. Cross-check all details before final submission.
The category (SC / ST / OBC-NCL / PwBD / EWS / UR) filled in the online application form will not be changed later.
Print the application confirmation page for future reference.
Pay the fee and complete the process well before the closing date and time, to avoid login failures due to heavy load on the website.
If the fee is not paid and the steps are not completed, the application will be incomplete and rejected.

HAL may reject any application at any stage if the candidate is found ineligible. If the information furnished is false or incomplete, the candidature will be revoked or terminated at any stage, or after joining.
Canvassing or influencing officials related to recruitment / selection will result in immediate disqualification.
Beware of fake e-mails, WhatsApp messages and SMS. Do not make payment to any individual or agency for securing employment in HAL.

content_sections.heading: HAL Junior Executive Recruitment 2026 – Quick Summary
content_sections.text: Who is recruiting? Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), a Maharatna Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. Which post? Junior Executive on Short Term Basis. How many vacancies? 150. Who can apply? Indian Nationals with a Regular / Full Time Degree in Engineering / Technology in an eligible discipline, with the minimum aggregate marks mentioned in the notification. Application start date: 07 October 2026 (14:00 hrs). Last date: 17 October 2026 (14:00 hrs). Application mode: Online only, through the Careers section of www.hal-india.co.in. Job location: Bengaluru and Tumakuru (Karnataka), Hyderabad (Telangana), Nasik (Maharashtra), Koraput (Odisha), Barrackpore (West Bengal), and Lucknow, Kanpur and Korwa (Uttar Pradesh).

content_sections.heading: HAL Junior Executive Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: HAL is looking for young, energetic and result oriented Graduate Engineers / Professionals for engagement as Junior Executives on Short Term Basis. The selected candidates will be posted across HAL's Production, Overhaul and Service Divisions, Research & Development Centres and Offices. Register for Job Alerts HAL is a Maharatna Central Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India, and a premier Aerospace and Defence Company in India. According to the notification, HAL has worked over the last eight decades on the design, development, manufacture, maintenance, repair, overhaul and upgrade of Aircraft, Helicopters, Aero-engines, Accessories, Avionics and Systems. HAL operates with 20 Divisions and 10 Research & Development Centres spread across seven States and ten geographical locations in India. HAL's major customers include the Indian Air Force, Indian Army, Indian Navy and Indian Coast Guard. HAL is also a key partner in the space programmes of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).

content_sections.heading: HAL Junior Executive Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: HAL has notified 150 vacancies for Junior Executive on Short Term Basis. Mechanical has the highest number of vacancies (78), followed by Electrical (25) and Electronics (21). The category-wise and discipline-wise breakup is given below. SC – Scheduled Caste; ST – Scheduled Tribe; OBC-NCL – Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer); EWS – Economically Weaker Sections; UR – Unreserved. OBC-NCL: The candidate must not belong to the Creamy Layer. OBC candidates who belong to the Creamy Layer are not entitled to the relaxation admissible to OBC-NCL and must indicate their category as UR in the application form. The name of the caste and community must appear in the Central List of Other Backward Classes. The OBC-NCL certificate must be in the prescribed format and not older than 6 months as on 17.10.2026, at the time of Interview, if called for. EWS: Reservation will be as per the prevalent Government Directives. PwBD: Reservation of vacancies for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) will be distributed among all categories, i.e. SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS and UR. PwBDs suffering from not less than 40% of the identified disability are eligible for the benefit of reservation. Candidates must submit the Disability Certificate issued by the Competent Authority in the prescribed format only. The notification mentions 06 vacancies reserved for PwBDs. This number is shown once for all disciplines in the notification, and a discipline-wise split is not specified. Abbreviations used in the notification: B = Blindness, LV = Low Vision, D = Deaf, HH = Hard of Hearing, OA = One Arm, BA = Both Arms, OL = One Leg, BL = Both Legs, OAL = One Arm & One Leg, BLOA = Both Legs & One Arm, BLA = Both Legs & Arms, CP = Cerebral Palsy, LC = Leprosy Cured, Dw = Dwarfism, AAV = Acid Attack Victims, SDD/SID = Spinal Deformity/Spinal Injury with associated Neurological / Limb dysfunction of respective Locomotor Disability (OA, BA, OL, BL, OAL, BLOA, BLA) identified for the particular post, SD/SI = Spinal Deformity/Spinal Injury without any associated Neurological / Limb dysfunction, ASD (M) = Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild), SLD = Specific Learning Disability, MD = Multiple Disabilities from amongst persons under Clauses (a) to (d) including deaf blindness.

SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS candidates not shortlisted under UR are regrouped with their respective categories and called in the ratio of 1:10 in their respective category. If marks in the qualifying examination are the same, the candidate who is elder or senior in age is considered first. Merely meeting the qualification does not entitle a candidate to be shortlisted for the Interview. All candidates called for Interview must produce certificates in original for all particulars declared in the Application Form at the Document Verification stage prior to the Interview. Candidates in SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS / PwBD (disability of 40% or more) categories must submit copies of the Caste Certificate / Income & Asset Certificate / Disability Certificate, as applicable, in the prescribed format at the time of Interview / Document Verification. Candidates employed in Central Government or State Government Departments, Public Sector Enterprises, Autonomous Organizations, Quasi Government Organizations, Armed Forces or Para-Military Forces (Regular, Contractual or on Contract basis) must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at Document Verification. If NOC does not apply, a document from the employer citing the same must be produced. Candidates who fail to submit these will not be permitted to appear for the Interview and will not be eligible for Travelling Allowance. Engagement is subject to verification of Caste / Income & Asset / Disability Certificate (wherever applicable) and Character & Antecedents. The vacancies are to be filled by external candidates only through Direct Recruitment. Applications of internal candidates, if any, will not be considered. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HAL Junior Executive Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must apply online only through the Careers section of the HAL website, www.hal-india.co.in, from 07.10.2026 (14:00 hrs) to 17.10.2026 (14:00 hrs). Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted. A valid e-mail ID that remains active till the completion of the Selection Process. A valid mobile number. Intimation about further stages such as the Interview will be sent to the same e-mail ID, and requests to change the mobile number or e-mail ID later will not be entertained. Soft copy of the latest passport size colour photograph and signature in .jpg format, less than 100 KB and 50 KB in size respectively. Educational details such as semester-wise marks. Employment details (if applicable). Apply for only ONE Engineering Discipline. If more than one application is submitted for different Disciplines, all such applications will be summarily rejected and the application fee paid, if any, will be forfeited. If more than one application is submitted for the same Discipline, only the last submitted application will be considered. An application once submitted cannot be altered under any circumstances. Cross-check all details before final submission. The category (SC / ST / OBC-NCL / PwBD / EWS / UR) filled in the online application form will not be changed later. Print the application confirmation page for future reference. Pay the fee and complete the process well before the closing date and time, to avoid login failures due to heavy load on the website. If the fee is not paid and the steps are not completed, the application will be incomplete and rejected. HAL may reject any application at any stage if the candidate is found ineligible. If the information furnished is false or incomplete, the candidature will be revoked or terminated at any stage, or after joining. Canvassing or influencing officials related to recruitment / selection will result in immediate disqualification. Beware of fake e-mails, WhatsApp messages and SMS. Do not make payment to any individual or agency for securing employment in HAL.

content_sections.heading: HAL Junior Executive Recruitment 2026 Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is HAL Junior Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: HAL Junior Executive Recruitment 2026 is an official notification released by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited to engage Graduate Engineers as Junior Executives on a short-term tenure basis for 150 vacancies across various engineering disciplines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in HAL Junior Executive 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 150 vacancies notified for Junior Executives on a short-term basis across disciplines including Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Civil, Computer Science, Production, Aeronautical, Chemical, and Metallurgy.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for HAL Junior Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 17.10.2026 up to 14:00 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for HAL Junior Executive?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a regular or full-time degree in engineering or technology in the relevant discipline/eligible branch from a recognized university or institute with minimum aggregate marks of 60% for UR/OBC-NCL/EWS and 50% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HAL Junior Executive posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not above 28 years as on 17th October, 2026 for UR and EWS category candidates, with permissible age relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for HAL Junior Executive?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/- (inclusive of 18% GST) for UR, OBC-NCL, and EWS candidates. Candidates belonging to SC, ST, and PwBD categories are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection done for HAL Junior Executive?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates is done exclusively through an Interview for shortlisted candidates meeting the eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary of a HAL Junior Executive?
faq.answer: Junior Executives are inducted in the E0 Pay Scale of Rs. 30,000 - 120,000/- with a basic pay of Rs. 30,000/- per month, dearness allowance, HRA, and a cafeteria allowance at 35% of basic pay along with other admissible company benefits.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job in HAL?
faq.answer: No, this engagement is purely on a short-term tenure basis for a maximum period of 3 years and does not confer any right to claim regular executive status.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply online for HAL Junior Executive 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official HAL website at www.hal-india.co.in under the careers section.
